title: ExpenseDecided v1
description: Emitted by expenses when a reviewer approves or rejects a claim. Delivered at least once to audit; event_id is stable across redeliveries. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

event_id.description: Unique per event, identical on every redelivery. Consumers deduplicate by it.

schema_version.description: Major version. Breaking changes increment it.

correlation_id.description: X-Request-ID of the API call that made the decision.

amount_cents.description: Exact amount that was decided, in minor units.

decided_by.description: Subject (sub) of the reviewer; never equal to employee_id.
